verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents event capture, tracking APIs, identity management and session replay, but no rule engine that automatically triggers actions when events occur. The pricing page's 'Report alerts' and 'Behavioral targeting' are bare plan-feature labels about reporting and targeting, not documented event-triggered automation rules, so they earn no credit. The axis applies to an analytics product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
